description: Fix #9, discriminant-validity family 1: the narrative conclusion is correct -- week 2 is the anomaly onset via new intermediaries, week 3 is the exfiltration phase to high-risk jurisdictions, matching this task's real ground truth -- but the report barely documents it: 1 of 13 gold transactions cited, plus one fabricated citation.

Week 3 exits funds to high-risk jurisdictions.

flag: DISCRIMINANT VALIDITY (fix #9): the conclusion here (week 2 onset, week 3 exfiltration to high-risk jurisdictions) matches this task's real ground truth (evidence-annotations.json's rationale) -- unlike task-007's 09/10 pair, this correctness is asserted by the fixture author, not mechanically verified against a structured findings.csv, since task-006's output shape (a CSV of per-week anomaly scores plus a narrative report) has no entity-classification ground truth to check against the way task-007's account roles do. Traceability, in contrast, IS mechanically poor here: 1 of 13 gold transactions matched, one fabricated citation, 2 of 3 claims unsupported.
